fact: On 27 June 2026 Université Nouveaux Horizons in Lubumbashi inaugurated Lofoyi, a 150 TFLOPS supercomputer (InfiniBand 100 Gbps) optimised for scientific computing, big data and artificial intelligence, described as the first academic supercomputer in the DRC and intended for the Congolese scientific community.
title: UNH inaugure son supercalculateur
